captions.instagram:
How does a car gear system work?

Three shafts, a row of gears that never unmesh, and a collar that slides to pick one. Open a five-speed gearbox in 3D, follow the power through every gear, and watch synchromesh match the speeds in slow motion.

→ A manual gearbox has three shafts, and every gear pair inside it is always in mesh.
→ An engine is only strong between about 2,000 and 6,000 rpm, but the wheels must go from zero to top speed.
→ So the car climbs through its gears, and the rev counter draws a sawtooth.
→ Push the lever and a collar slides sideways, locking one free-spinning gear to the output shaft.
→ Fourth gear is direct: the two shafts lock into one bar and no gear teeth carry the load.

Play with it yourself. It's free and open source: glassbox.how/gearboxclear (link in bio)

youtubeLong.title: How does a car gear system work? (interactive explainer)
youtubeLong.description:
Three shafts, a row of gears that never unmesh, and a collar that slides to pick one. Open a five-speed gearbox in 3D, follow the power through every gear, and watch synchromesh match the speeds in slow motion.

▶ Play with the interactive version: https://glassbox.how/e/gearboxclear/
⌘ Source code (MIT): https://github.com/bdeeps/gearboxclear

In this video:
• Three shafts, and gears that never unmesh. A classic manual gearbox has an input shaft from the clutch, a layshaft below it, and a main shaft out to the wheels.
• Why an engine needs gears. A petrol engine only pulls well between about 2,000 and 6,000 rpm, and cannot run near zero.
• Follow the power. In first, the power goes down to the layshaft and back up through a 14-tooth gear driving 33: with the 22 to 31 input pair that makes 3.32 to 1.
• Synchromesh matches the speeds. The collar turns with the wheels and the gear with the engine side, so their teeth would clash.
• The differential shares the drive. In the axle a 10-tooth pinion turns a 39-tooth crown wheel: the final drive.
• Four kinds of automatic. A torque converter passes power through oil and uses planetary gear sets.
